beta.notes:
Native Plex client for MiSTer. Built for CRTs at 480i over Component, RGB, S-Video or Composite, with 480p on HDMI.

Beta access. This is a paid early-access build. Install and browsing work without a code. Playback needs the code from the MisterZine Patreon post. Stable releases will be free and codeless.

New in beta.9
- Sound stays in sync with the picture for the whole video. MiSTer's audio ran about 0.2% slow, so over a long episode the sound slid up to a third of a second behind the picture before catching up again; beta.9 plays it at the right speed. If playback hiccups, the sound now snaps back into sync by itself instead of staying out of step until you skip, and videos with small gaps in their timing no longer drift.
- Also restores the playback sync improvements from beta.3, which betas 4 to 8 were missing.
- Send a report from Options. Choose Options > Send a report and the app sends its logs, the video settings it reads from MiSTer.ini, which MiSTer main is running and the framebuffer state as one report, then shows a short code. Post that code where you asked for help instead of copying files off the SD card. Reports can name media titles and playback details; sign-in tokens, the server address and account files are never included, and reports are deleted after 30 days.

Requirements
- Networked MiSTer on current MiSTer Linux
- 250 MB free on the SD card
- Plex account with a server that can transcode

Install
1. Download the Beta installer below and put it in the SD card's Scripts folder.
2. Run it from Scripts.
3. Follow the sign-in screen at plex.tv/link.

Already on an earlier beta: open Options > Updates in the app and install from there.

NTSC 480i only; PAL isn't supported yet.

This is unstable beta software. It talks to your real Plex account: playback, watched marks and resume points change your library, and a bug could change them wrongly. Use it at your own risk; no responsibility is taken for what it does to your library or your MiSTer.
